title: Simultaneous curve test for two local eigenvalues of a simple lisse quotient
statement: Let $k_0$ be a finite field, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$ a prime, and $X_0$ a smooth affine finite-type $k_0$-scheme. Use the source pro-etale Weil category [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], its lisse predicate [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves], and local Frobenius and weights [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace; def-weil-punctual-weights]. Let $i:G_1\hookrightarrow G_2$ and $j:G_2\hookrightarrow G$ be monomorphisms of lisse Weil sheaves, with $V=\operatorname{coker}(i)$ nonzero irreducible lisse. For arbitrary closed points $x,y\in X_0$ and local Frobenius eigenvalues $\alpha,\beta$ of $V$ at $x,y$, there exist a finite extension $k_1/k_0$ with $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_1)$, a smooth geometrically connected affine separated finite-type curve $C/k_1$, lisse Weil sheaves $H,H_1,H_2$ on $C$, monomorphisms $a:H_1\hookrightarrow H_2$ and $b:H_2\hookrightarrow H$ with irreducible lisse cokernel, closed points $s,t\in C$, and $e,f\ge1$ such that: for every coefficient embedding $\iota$, reality of $G$ [def-wf-iota-real] implies reality of $H$; $q_s=q_x^e$, $q_t=q_y^f$; $\alpha^e,\beta^f$ are local eigenvalues of $\operatorname{coker}(a)$ at $s,t$; and a morphism $c:C\to X_0$ carries $s,t$ to $x,y$ and satisfies $c\gg p_X=p_C\gg\operatorname{Spec}(k_0\to k_1)$, where $p_X,p_C$ are the structural morphisms and composition is in diagrammatic order. The points may coincide. No weight, purity or mixedness is assumed or concluded. Zero-dimensional support is allowed.

proof.text: An eigenvalue alpha^e of the intermediate quotient gives (alpha^e)^r on the r-th Frobenius power, by Module.End.HasEigenvalue.pow; equality of characteristic polynomials transfers that eigenvalue to the curve. Thus the final exponents are e*r and f*s. Compose the two residue-cardinality powers by pow_mul. Give the final field the composed algebra map, compose the two scheme maps, verify the structural square by contravariant Spec.map_comp, and compose their point images. Reality implications compose. This is the complete final Lean proof.

theorem exists_pair_eigenvalue_curve_test
    {k₀ : Type u} [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime]
    [Fact (ringChar k₀ ≠ l)] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] [IsAffine X]
    [Smooth (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    {G : WeilSheaf k₀ l X} (hG : G.IsLisse) {G₁ G₂ : WeilSheaf k₀ l X}
    (i : G₁ ⟶ G₂) (j : G₂ ⟶ G) [Mono i] [Mono j]
    (h₁ : G₁.IsLisse) (h₂ : G₂.IsLisse)
    (hirr : (cokernel i).IsIrreducibleLisse)
    (x y : X.finitePoints) (α β : PadicAlgCl l)
    (hα : ((cokernel i).stalk x).frobeniusEnd.HasEigenvalue α)
    (hβ : ((cokernel i).stalk y).frobeniusEnd.HasEigenvalue β) :
    ∃ (k₁ : Type u) (_ : Field k₁) (_ : Finite k₁) (_ : Algebra k₀ k₁)
      (_ : Fact (ringChar k₁ ≠ l)) (C : Scheme.{u})
      (_ : C.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁))) (_ : IsAffine C)
      (_ : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)))
      (_ : GeometricallyConnected (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)))
      (_ : IsSeparated (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)))
      (_ : LocallyOfFiniteType (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)))
      (_ : QuasiCompact (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)))
      (H H₁ H₂ : WeilSheaf k₁ l C) (a : H₁ ⟶ H₂) (b : H₂ ⟶ H)
      (_ : Mono a) (_ : Mono b),
      H.IsLisse ∧ H₁.IsLisse ∧ H₂.IsLisse ∧ (cokernel a).IsIrreducibleLisse ∧
      (∀ ι : PadicAlgCl l →+* ℂ, G.IsReal ι → H.IsReal ι) ∧
      ∃ (s t : C.finitePoints) (e f : ℕ), 0 < e ∧ 0 < f ∧
        (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)).residueCard s.1 =
          (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).residueCard x.1 ^ e ∧
        (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)).residueCard t.1 =
          (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).residueCard y.1 ^ f ∧
        ((cokernel a).stalk s).frobeniusEnd.HasEigenvalue (α ^ e) ∧
        ((cokernel a).stalk t).frobeniusEnd.HasEigenvalue (β ^ f) ∧
        ∃ c : C ⟶ X,
          c ≫ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) =
            (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)) ≫
              Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k₀ k₁)) ∧
          c s.1 = x.1 ∧ c t.1 = y.1
